mechanism: Turmeric (curcumin) inhibits CYP1A2 and CYP3A4, potentially increasing mexiletine plasma concentrations since mexiletine is metabolized by CYP1A2.
action: Monitor mexiletine levels and clinical effects; consider mexiletine dose reduction if turmeric supplementation is initiated; assess for signs of mexiletine toxicity (tremor, dizziness, cardiac arrhythmias).
